task: Redesign the Drum Library UI folder area
summary: The Drum Library is NOT a separate page - it is a MODE within SampleBrowserPage activated by the libraryMode_ flag. The folder area consists of a TreeView (folderTreeView_) with FolderTreeItem nodes, a collapsible panel controlled by folderPanelToggle_, and custom painting in paint(). Redesign can safely modify the library mode-specific UI without affecting normal SampleBrowserPage behavior.
